_help: First task per card (atlas/CURATION.md "Cards v2"): one simple first step for a newcomer, human or agent. Only tasks a curator has run and verified are listed, with credit to the contributor. Cards without a task show no first-task block. A task that downloads code and runs it must check the file's SHA-256 (`sha256sum -c`, the hash recorded in verification) in a step between the download and the run, and should say to run it in a sandbox without secrets; optional `no_code` gives a way to finish the task without running code.

touchstone.title: Check which clock a liveness record was measured on
steps: Work in a clean sandbox that holds no keys, tokens or other secrets: a fresh container (for example `docker run --rm -it python:3.12 bash`) or a new Python venv on a spare machine. The script needs only Python 3 and the internet.

Check the file against the hash we verified, before running it: `echo "8634b6564c8d6404987c5dfb3e380c6b39c6ebc81dcf8ae6224fe0cf3b50ba5f  liveness-verify.py" | sha256sum -c -`. Go on only when it prints `liveness-verify.py: OK`; any other output means the file changed, so stop here and leave it unrun.
Run `python3 liveness-verify.py --selftest`; it prints "SELFTEST OK — 27 checks".
Run `python3 liveness-verify.py rec_01m1hbq666jjjyfw7s6tf7h2rd` (The Colony's notarisation feed) and read the first two lines.
touchstone.done_when: You can say which clock each row was measured on: tsa = an independent RFC 3161 timestamp, server = the server's own time.
touchstone.no_code: Open https://touchstone.cv/.well-known/touchstone/checkpoints/rec_01m1hbq666jjjyfw7s6tf7h2rd in a browser. A checkpoint with an `anchors` entry of method `tsa` and an `external_ts` time was measured on the tsa clock; every other checkpoint is on the server clock (its `created_at`).
touchstone.verification: Script sha256 8634b6564c8d6404987c5dfb3e380c6b39c6ebc81dcf8ae6224fe0cf3b50ba5f (checked with sha256sum -c); self-test 27 of 27 checks; readout of the record ran to exit code 0; the feed URL opens in a browser (HTTP 200).
